text: {"score":2,"justification":"Core numbers (10.5%, 2.2%, 6.88, z 1.11, 51%, 16/0, 9%, 2 of 29, 4%) match the card. But the rationale has several unsupported or inconsistent claims. It states 'every complexity band' has 99215 share above the all-provider rate, which is false for the 4-condition band (0.143 vs 0.117 is above, fine) but the claim holds; however the 'late 9%', 'problems 33%', 'repeated times about one in eight' and 'audit trail' details are not on the card (some may come from tool output, and 33 was unmatched). The 'repeated times about one in eight' is not in the listed note-check figures (late 9%, unsigned 0%). The summary also says 'The claims pattern is consistent with upcoding' while leaning 'inconclusive', and the headline says 'claims and charts point in opposite directions', yet then speculates on templated notes from only two documented examples. It cites C0213237 and C0213620 as J06.9 visits with no chronic conditions documented at high MDM; that matches the card. But the 'sampled low-complexity 99215s ... low back pain and abdominal pain (C0212917, C0212922, C0213409)' cites J06.9, J06.9, M54.50, so abdominal pain is not covered by those cites. Next steps are weak: the chart request starts with C0212816 and C0213724, which are below-billed 99213/99214 claims, not 99215s, and contradicts the stated target of 99215 charts. The cited claims in examples are mixed and not the strongest ones (the high-MDM J06.9 claims are not cited). The result is usable in part but contains citation mismatches and unsupported statements.","problems":["Next step asks for 'targeted sample of 99215 charts' but starts with C0212816 and C0213724, which are 99213/99214 claims","Abdominal pain claim cited with C0212917, C0212922, C0213409, which are J06.9, J06.9, M54.50 — abdominal pain not supported by those cites","'About one in eight showed repeated times' is not backed by the card; number 33 unmatched","Speculation about templated/inflated notes drawn from only two examples, while leaning is 'inconclusive' and text says 'consistent with upcoding'","Cited claim IDs omit the key high-MDM J06.9 claims C0213237 and C0213620 discussed in the text","Documentation rate comparison '9%' is the all-provider 99215 rate, fine, but 'late 9%' and 'problems 33%' are not verifiable from the card"]}
